_doc: Formula v2 class anchors (BALANCE_PIPELINE.md §5, DESIGN §12 second iteration). Each class prices by normalized deviation from its anchor: Cost = cost0 * (O/O0 + P/P0 + Q/Q0) / 3 — exact at the anchor. Anchors are MAINTAINER picks, validated by tools/balance/fit_class.py before sign-off. Classes without an entry keep the global Tiger formula.

closecombat.comment: LIVING BASELINE td_gdi_shotgunner 50000/75/3500 SA+CG burst5 bd0 (WC .875, eff DPS 233.33) = 200. VERIFIER asianalliance_fanatic 2x HP + 2x bursts (burst10) @ 500 (identity exact). Band [2500,4500). All members use SmallArms+Chaingun; SoundVolume = 1/burst; BurstDelays 0; damage split 2000+2000 per shot in 2000-steps. Tier factor 0.75=T3.
closecombat.dps_convention: SmallArms + Chaingun warhead damages summed, WC 0.875

mbt.comment: The Naxis Tiger Tank baseline (design 2026-07-11) — the global formula IS this anchor, kept for reference. O0=P0=Q0=cost0=800 by construction.

scout.comment: LIVING BASELINE: naxis_naxiriflesoldier 20000/60/5000/4000@50 SA ground-only (WC .75, DPS 60) = 100 (took over from japan_imperialscoutsman, which moved to special_forces 2026-07-20; anchor values unchanged). VERIFIER: forgotten_mutantsoldier 2x/2x @ 250 (identity exact). Bands: range 4500-5500 hard, speed +/-20% prov.; price envelope 50-250; cost<=150 SA only (.75), else SA+CG (.875). Scouts never hit air.

special_forces.comment: LIVING BASELINE japan_imperialscoutsman 15000/50/6000/6000@50 (SmallArms+Chaingun+Railgun-AP, air-capable, bullet projectile, WC 1.0, DPS 120) = 200. Fragile long-range versatile anti-air/anti-armor specialist (contrast the 50000-HP closecombat brawler). Band 5500-6500 (r0 6000). Air is the CLASS trait, never a per-unit special. ^SpecialForcesInfantryTemplate. VERIFIER TBD (2x HP + 2x dmg, same rng/spd -> 500).
special_forces.dps_convention: light+medium+heavy warhead triad summed (SA+Chaingun+Railgun on the baseline; CannonAP+Flak+Laser or SA+Chaingun+Laser on members), WC 1.0. *ExtraDamage warheads are shield-only chip and EXCLUDED from the sum.
special_forces.verifier_comment: T1 (no tech penalty) clean tripwire: schwarzermond_lunarsoldier 30000/50/6000 SA+Chaingun+Laser 12000@50 (2x/2x) = 500.00 exact. Makes SM basic infantry strong on purpose (in-game test flagged). NOTE: td_nod_lasertrooper is NOT the verifier - it is Tier 4 (temple prime, 0.5x factor), re-priced as a 4x/4x=750 heavy SF trooper instead.
